question: Should this PR be the serialized v0.38.4 release gate, including the Homebrew fix already proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1090?
rationale: The implementation and proof are sufficient, but automation cannot decide whether to cut v0.38.4 now, which overlapping PR should land, or how to sequence the dependent follow-up.

options.title: Use this release PR
options.body: Merge this PR as the v0.38.4 release gate, then close https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1090 as contained and proceed with the queued follow-up.

options.title: Land the fix separately
options.body: Merge https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1090 first and regenerate or rebase the release metadata when maintainers are ready to cut v0.38.4.

recommendation.title: Use this release PR
recommendation.body: Merge this PR as the v0.38.4 release gate, then close https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1090 as contained and proceed with the queued follow-up.
